reasoning: The claim is a well-documented myth. The Great Wall of China is not visible from space with the unaided (naked) eye because it is only about 5 to 9 meters wide and blends into the surrounding terrain and materials. Furthermore, it is not the "only" man-made structure visible from orbit; other human-made features such as major highways, large dams, agricultural fields, airports, and city lights at night are far more easily discerned from low Earth orbit without magnification.
